label: Index-matched trend
desc: One slow EWMA trend filter at group delay 110, class budgets fitted once to the SG CTA index and frozen, 10% vol target. The flagship book.
rule: EWMATrend gd 110 · cap ±2 · class budget rates 36 / equities 22 / commodities 22 / FX 19 / VIX 1 · VolCorr gearing · 10% target, 4× cap
config:
macro_sgcta:
  target_risk: 0.1
  base_currency: USD
  constructor:
    type: RiskWeighted
    params: {}
  models:
  - name: trend_shop_sgcta
    risk_weight: 1.0
    timing:
      type: None
  portfolio_gearing:
    type: VolTarget
    params:
      target_vol: 0.1
      vol_lookback: 63
  portfolio_timing:
    type: None
  risk_controls:
  - type: LeverageLimit
    params:
      max_leverage: 4.0
  sizing:
    fx:
      HKD: 0.12749
      KRW: 0.000733
      SGD: 0.78555
trend_shop_sgcta:
  asset_classes:
  - crypto
  - futures
  - fx
  universe_filters:
  - type: ListingFilter
  - type: PrimaryOnly
  - type: AdvFilter
    params:
      min_adv: 50000000
      lookback: 63
  vol_estimator:
    type: EWMA2
    params:
      hl_1: 5
      hl_2: 10
  vol_normalizer:
    type: Standard
    params:
      target_vol: 0.1
      vol_floor: 0.05
  signal_defaults:
    vol_estimator:
      type: EWMA2
      params:
        span: 32
    capper:
      type: SymmetricCap
      params:
        lower: -2
        upper: 2
    position_function:
      type: CappedLinear
      params:
        scalar: 1
        cap: 2
  signals:
  - type: TimeSeriesSignal
    weight: 1.0
    params:
      indicator:
        type: EWMATrend
        params:
          group_delay: 110
          n_stages: 2
  asset_allocator:
    type: ClassBudget
    params:
      level: asset_class
      budgets:
        rates: 0.36
        equity_index: 0.22
        commodity: 0.22
        fx: 0.19
        volatility: 0.01
        crypto: 0.0
  model_gearing:
    type: VolCorr
    params:
      target_vol: 0.1
      asset_vol_target: 0.1
      corr_lookback: 504
      signal_lookback: 0
      leverage_cap: 5.0
  cost_model:
    type: FixedBPS
    params:
      cost_bps: 2.0
